title: Adopt lessons from 'How we made claude.ai 3x faster'
description: The post hill-climbs on deterministic proxies (Valgrind instructions, V8 call counts, React commits) each proven to move wall time, turns every metric into a CI ratchet, uses flags/staged rollout, and a human complexity veto; agents needed pushing to be bolder. Propose an ADR-0005 amendment (validated proxy as the fast inner loop, wall-clock to confirm), a ratchet mode for perf-ci, and an explicit complexity-escalation rule.

acceptanceCriteria.text: An ADR amending 0005 is put to the owner with two options
perf-ci has a ratchet mode with a test proving a lowered budget cannot be raised by a PR
The source is reviewed first-hand and cited in docs/reference
